patches.title: Systematic Countertop Survey
patches.principle: Visit all countertops to find the target object before searching other furniture.
patches.when_to_apply: When the target object is not visible on the initial countertop.

patches.title: Immediate Destination Preparation
patches.principle: Open the destination container immediately upon arrival before placing the cleaned object.
patches.when_to_apply: When you have a cleaned object and are at the destination container.

patches.title: No Post-Cleaning Detours
patches.principle: After cleaning, go directly to the destination without any intermediate stops or actions.
patches.when_to_apply: When you have just cleaned an object and need to place it.
